notablePrerequisites: You have a storm count of at least three.
description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Aeve by paying {5}.
Aeve's storm ability triggers, creating a token copy of Aeve for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve the first Aeve spell.
Aeve enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding {C} for each Ooze you control.
Repeat from step 4 for each Aeve spell remaining.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {2}, returning the nontoken Aeve from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
